segment_summaries.content: Section heading: one-to-one mapping of systems S_{n rho} onto systems S*_{rho rho}.
segment_summaries.choices: Ein-eindeutig continues the existing bijective lane: взаємно однозначне / взаимно однозначное / vzaimno jednoznačno.

segment_summaries.content: The auxiliary lemma gives the mapping by replacing some indeterminates with numbers; algebraic rank becomes the characteristic number.
segment_summaries.choices: Abbildung rendered as mapping/відображення/отображение/odobraženje, not as a geometric map only.

segment_summaries.content: Choice of algebraically independent functions g_1,...,g_rho and arbitrary f(x); the two systems satisfy the auxiliary lemma.
segment_summaries.choices: Kept the footnote about renumbering indeterminates.

segment_summaries.content: Choose a_n,...,a_{rho+1} so rank is preserved; define f* by successive substitutions; numerator and denominator do not vanish identically.
segment_summaries.choices: Mirrors Section 2 specialization notation and reduced-function safety language.

segment_summaries.content: Let f(x) run through all functions of the original system and consider the system of all resulting f* functions.
Property 1: the image system has rank rho and is denoted S*_{rho rho}; footnote defines mapping functions.
segment_summaries.choices: Abbildungsfunktionen rendered as functions of the mapping / functions of x_1,...,x_rho.

segment_summaries.content: Property 2: the assignment f(x) to f*(x) is without exception one-to-one.
segment_summaries.choices: Zuordnung/prirędženje vocabulary links this to earlier bijective-correspondence choices.

segment_summaries.content: Proof of injectivity using d(x)=f_1-f_2 and the auxiliary lemma.
segment_summaries.choices: Difference argument and nonzero implications are preserved as displayed formulas.

segment_summaries.content: Property 3: relations among image functions imply the corresponding relations among original functions.
segment_summaries.choices: Relations are translated as співвідношення / соотношения / relacije, matching the transfer-principle context.

segment_summaries.content: Nonzero rational combination h remains nonzero after mapping, completing the proof.
segment_summaries.choices: q. e. d. retained as source-style proof marker.
Rendered as a brief prose lead-in rather than a separate theorem environment.

segment_summaries.content: Theorem I: every S_{n rho} can be one-to-one assigned to S*_{rho rho}; relations are preserved both ways; fields map to fields.
segment_summaries.choices: Long theorem statement kept italic and source-faithful; visual audit confirmed no clipping.

segment_summaries.content: Consequence: relation-characterized properties transfer from mapping systems to original systems.
segment_summaries.choices: Abbildungssystem rendered directly and review-flagged in Interslavic as odobražajuči sistem.
